answer: Sybil resistance comes from one-identity-one-stake: before an agent may vote or earn, it must lock a slashable bond under a unique on-chain anchor. Double-signing or forged attestations are provably slashable, so the bond is forfeited. To field N fake voices an attacker must lock N separate bonds; no shortcut exists by parking clones on a bare knoll. Even a hidden stand of juniper puppets costs one bond apiece, so scaling an attack scales its loss linearly.
